item.description: The passenger in a taxi that came under fire on Tuesday in central Düsseldorf has been confirmed to be Dutch, according to the public prosecutor in the German city, speaking to news agency dpa.

item.title: More supermarkets open on New Year’s Day, especially in big cities
item.description: More supermarkets are staying open on New Year’s Day. A decade ago, just 10 percent of stores operated on January 1; today, 45 percent are open, up from 43 percent last year.
